stories.headline: Mother’s Day, but Make It Platinum
stories.body: Mother’s Day is the annual moment when otherwise rational adults look into the maw of modern commerce and ask a spiritually revealing question: Is brunch enough? Usually, yes. But at the far edge of the digital economy, Mother’s Day has quietly become a glorious, over-caffeinated payments event: part emotion, part logistics, part luxury checkout
